limitations: Outcome-informed supervised representation benchmark after known LLM findings. Test labels excluded from fitting/tuning. Supervised label/sample budget differs from zero-shot LLM; not a fair algorithm ranking or proof of input sufficiency/mechanism. LORO changes both regime support and training size.
No p values or bootstrap CIs. Records and repeated LLM calls are dependent; report nine test specimens and per-call descriptive comparisons.
Structural prediction checks test fixed row-wise software behavior; they do not identify a causal mechanism or remove supervised-information differences.
LORO combined reuses the same nine specimens; 12 LLM calls reuse the same 36 records. No aggregated 432-independent-record comparison.
